get.summary: Lists child folders under a parent (defaults to the tenant root).
get.description: Returns the children of the folder identified by the optional `parentId` query parameter. When `parentId` is omitted, the children of the invisible tenant root are returned. The tenant root itself is always filtered out of the result set. Pass `?status=Trashed` to read the trash listing for the same parent (F8.1); the default is `Active`.

post.summary: Creates a folder under the given parent (or under the tenant root).
post.description: Creates a new folder under `parentFolderId`. When `parentFolderId` is omitted the folder is created directly under the invisible tenant root, which is auto-bootstrapped on first access for the tenant. The folder name is validated against length, the reserved path separator '/', and parent-scoped uniqueness.

get.description: Returns the folder identified by `id`, including the materialised path and depth. Returns 404 when the folder does not exist or when the caller's tenant filter excludes it. The tenant root itself is also returned as 404 because it is not user-visible.

patch.description: Renames the folder identified by `id`. The materialised path is recomputed atomically. Descendant paths are updated by the move-folder endpoint (F2.4) — rename does not modify descendants. The tenant root cannot be renamed.

delete.summary: Sends a folder to the trash (soft-delete).
delete.description: Moves the folder identified by `id` to the trash. Cascade-trashes every active descendant folder and document in a single transaction (F8.1). Permanent deletion happens after the configured retention period via the empty-trash background job (F8/F9.2). The tenant root cannot be trashed.

get.summary: Returns the chain of ancestors plus the folder itself.
get.description: Returns the chain of folders from the first user-visible ancestor (closest to the tenant root) down to and including the folder identified by `id`. The invisible tenant root is excluded from the chain so the client never has to know about it. Returns 404 when the folder does not exist or is the tenant root.

post.summary: Moves a folder under a new parent.
post.description: Moves the folder identified by `id` under `newParentFolderId` (or under the invisible tenant root when omitted). The materialised path and depth of the moved folder AND every descendant are re-materialised in a single SQL UPDATE within the same transaction. Cycles, cross-tenant moves, and moves under a trashed or descendant target are rejected. The tenant root cannot be moved.

put.summary: Transfers folder ownership to another user.
put.description: Replaces `OwnerId` with the user identified by `newOwnerId`. The previous owner loses any owner-based access derived from `OwnedByCurrentUserHandler`; explicit share grants on this folder survive the transfer. Emits a `FolderOwnerChangedEvent` for the ISO 27001 audit trail. The tenant root cannot be transferred (422). Returns 422 when `newOwnerId` is empty or when the folder is trashed; 404 when the folder is missing.

post.description: Sets the folder identified by `id` back to `Active`. Descendants stay trashed unless restored individually (per F8.1 — restore is non-cascading by design). Returns 404 when the folder is missing or not currently trashed; 409 when the parent folder is itself trashed (callers must restore the parent first).

post.summary: Issues a presigned upload ticket for direct client-to-cloud transfer.
post.description: Issues a presigned PUT URL backed by Granit.BlobStorage. The client uploads the bytes directly to the configured cloud provider (no proxying through the API), then calls POST /documents/finalize with the returned blobId. Tickets expire after the BlobStorage-configured TTL (default 15 minutes).

post.summary: Confirms the upload and creates the Document + initial version.
post.description: Confirms with BlobStorage that the bytes have arrived and pass validation, then atomically creates the Document aggregate plus its initial v1 DocumentVersion under the requested folder (or the tenant root when folderId is omitted). Returns 422 when the blob fails validation, 404 when the target folder is missing.

post.summary: Appends a new version to an existing document.
post.description: Confirms with BlobStorage that the bytes have arrived and pass validation, then atomically appends a new DocumentVersion under the parent document with VersionNumber = max + 1 and updates Document.CurrentVersionId. Optimistic concurrency on Document.ConcurrencyStamp plus the unique index on (DocumentId, VersionNumber) protect concurrent uploaders. Returns 422 when the blob fails validation or the document is trashed; 404 when the document is missing or excluded by the tenant filter.

get.summary: Lists the version history of a document.
get.description: Returns a paged slice of the document's version history ordered by VersionNumber descending (latest first). The currently-active version is flagged via `isCurrent: true`. Use `?skip=` and `?take=` to page; defaults are skip=0, take=50 (max 200). Returns 404 when the document is missing or excluded by the tenant filter.

get.summary: Lists trashed documents for the current tenant (F8.2).
get.description: Returns a paged slice of trashed documents ordered by `TrashedAt` descending. Each row carries `daysUntilPermanentDeletion`, derived from the trash retention window (`GranitDocumentsOptions.TrashRetentionDays`, default 30 days). Defaults are `skip=0` and `take=50` (max 200).
Returns the document identified by `id`, including its current version pointer and folder placement. 404 when the document is not found or excluded by the tenant filter.

patch.summary: Renames a document and / or updates its description.
patch.description: Partial update — fields left null are unchanged. Send `clearDescription: true` to drop the description (sending an empty string sets a non-null empty value, which is rarely what callers want). 404 when the document is missing; 409 when the document is trashed.

delete.summary: Sends a document to the trash (soft-delete).
delete.description: Moves the document identified by `id` to the trash. Permanent deletion happens after the configured retention period via the empty-trash background job (F8 / F9.2). Already-trashed documents surface as 409.

post.summary: Moves a document under a different folder.
post.description: Moves the document identified by `id` under `newFolderId` (or under the tenant root when omitted). Cross-tenant moves and moves into trashed or missing folders surface as 409 Conflict.

put.summary: Transfers document ownership to another user.
put.description: Replaces `OwnerId` with the user identified by `newOwnerId`. The previous owner loses any owner-based access derived from `OwnedByCurrentUserHandler`; explicit share grants on this document survive the transfer. Emits a `DocumentOwnerChangedEvent` for the ISO 27001 audit trail. Returns 422 when `newOwnerId` is empty or when the document is trashed / permanently deleted; 404 when the document is missing.

post.description: Sets the document identified by `id` back to `Active`. Returns 404 when the document is missing or not currently trashed; 409 when the parent folder is itself trashed (callers must restore the folder first).

delete.description: Soft-deletes every version's `BlobDescriptor` (the bytes are removed; the audit row is retained per `Granit.BlobStorage`'s 3-year retention), decrements the tenant's storage quota by the released bytes, and promotes the document to `Status = PermanentlyDeleted` (tombstone for the GDPR / ISO 27001 audit trail). Emits `DocumentPermanentlyDeletedEvent`. Returns 204 on success, 404 when the document is missing or not currently trashed.

get.summary: Issues a presigned download URL for a document version.
get.description: Returns a JSON response carrying a short-lived presigned URL the client can use to download the bytes directly from the configured cloud provider. Defaults to the document's CurrentVersionId; pass `?versionId={guid}` to download a specific historical version. Emits a DocumentDownloadedEvent for the ISO 27001 audit trail and increments granit.documents.download.count. Returns 404 when the document or version is not found, 409 when the document is trashed or has no current version yet.

get.summary: Lists every tag currently assigned to a document.
get.description: Proxy over Granit.Taxonomy: returns the tags assigned to the document with TargetType = Granit.Documents.Domain.Document. The canonical store lives in Taxonomy; this endpoint is purely a UX shortcut on the Documents surface. Permission: Documents.Documents.Read.

post.summary: Assigns a tag to a document.
post.description: Idempotent assignment: re-posting the same (document, tag) pair returns the existing row instead of creating a duplicate. Delegates to Granit.Taxonomy's TagAssignmentService. Permission: Documents.Documents.Manage.

delete.summary: Removes a tag assignment from a document.
delete.description: Deletes the (document, tag) assignment row. Returns 404 when no row matches (typically because the tag was never assigned, or has already been removed). Permission: Documents.Documents.Manage.

get.summary: Lists active share grants on a folder.
get.description: Returns the share grants on the folder identified by `folderId`, ordered by creation time. Expired grants are excluded. The path-based inheritance (F6.4) is not flattened in this listing — callers see only grants directly attached to this folder.

post.summary: Grants a share on a folder.
post.description: Creates a `DocumentShare` row targeting the folder identified by `folderId`. When `isDefault` is true (the default), the grant inherits to descendants via the path-based effective-permission resolver introduced by F6.4 — F6.1 only persists the flag.

get.summary: Lists active share grants on a document.
get.description: Returns the share grants on the document identified by `documentId`, ordered by creation time. Expired grants are excluded. Inherited grants from the document's parent folder are not included — see the F6.5 effective ACL field on document list responses for the resolved view.

post.summary: Grants a share on a document.
post.description: Creates a `DocumentShare` row targeting the document identified by `documentId`. The `isDefault` flag is ignored for document shares.

delete.description: Deletes the share row identified by `id` and emits `DocumentShareRevokedEvent` for downstream cache invalidation (F6.3). Returns 404 when the share does not exist or is excluded by the tenant filter.

get.summary: Returns the current tenant's storage quota usage.
get.description: Returns the active `LimitBytes` / `UsageBytes` pair for the calling tenant plus a precomputed `percentUsed` ratio. The quota row is lazy-created on first call (mirrors the F2.2 tenant-root bootstrap), so a brand-new tenant always sees `UsageBytes = 0` instead of a 404. Returns 401 when the request carries no tenant context.

get.summary: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of Document entries.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against Document using the Granit query engine. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult instead (same status code, different shape).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Document (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Document: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.
